response.justification: The candidate is a seasoned generalist engineer with ~18 years of experience, strong TypeScript/Node.js production work, cloud/DevOps exposure, and recent hands-on involvement with MCP tooling and agentic-workflow infrastructure. However, the role requires 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and the resume shows only about one year of GenAI-adjacent work with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, or evaluation/observability pipelines for AI systems. Teaching and workshop experience suggests customer-facing potential, but the core AI depth expected at staff level for this role is not demonstrated.
strengths: 18+ years of production software engineering across web, backend, and embedded systems
Recent hands-on experience with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow tooling
Proven communicator via workshops, talks, and courses — relevant to forward-deployed work
concerns: Falls far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI work)
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience
Limited evidence of leading technical discovery or enterprise customer-facing delivery

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and TypeScript/cloud background
